question: As of March 2023 India men's Soccer team captain Sunil Chhetri became the __________ highest goal Scorer in International Football appearances.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fifth.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sunil Chhetri** became the** fifth-highest goal scorer** in international football appearances as of **March 2023.**
 
• He surpassed the **legendary Lionel Messi**, who was in the **sixth position** with **72 goals.**
 
• Sunil Chhetri has scored** 74 goals in 117 appearances **for India.
 
• He is regarded as one of the **greatest footballers **in Indian history and has won numerous awards and accolades.
 
• Sunil Chhetri is known for his exceptional **skills, speed, and agility** on the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football** is a family of** team sports** where goal-scoring is achieved through **kicking a ball **to differing degrees.
 
• The **Football League**, the first of many professional football associations, was established in **England in 1888**.
 
• The worldwide governing organization of futsal, beach soccer, and association football is called the **Fédération internationale de football association**. 
 
• It was established in **1904 **to supervise national associations from **Belgium, Denmark, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, and Switzerland** in their international rivalry. 
 
• **211** national associations currently make up its membership, which is headquartered in **Zürich, Switzerland. **
